implementation_summary: End-to-end test of Tamil and Hindi through the real audit crawl, page recorder and pipeline in Chromium over fixtures/audit-site. It checks code-point-exact text in extraction and in the Markdown, site.json and Word exports (including ZWJ/ZWNJ via a synthetic page), findings parity with the English page, language detection (ta, hi), and Audit Documents by language under DEC-005 (Tamil in Tamil with no beta label; Hindi in English with the English beta note in HTML, Markdown and Word; documentText('hi') still Hindi).
tests_proposed: Export bundle zip: unzip and compare site.json bytes to buildSiteJson for the Tamil page
PDF glyph shaping for Tamil and Hindi (manual waiver)
risks: The test takes about 40 s and runs in the unit project until QA-713 adds it to BROWSER_TESTS.core.
handoff: QA-713 should add audit-languages-e2e to BROWSER_TESTS.core. The orchestrator can run CHK-QA-711-LANGUAGES.
